description.value: Juillet Cafe is a specialty cafe established in July 2016 in the Lougheed neighbourhood of Burnaby, with a particular focus on premium matcha, hojicha, and espresso drinks alongside house-made pastries, cakes, and sandwiches. The cafe positions itself as a community hub, hosting events and workshops centred on coffee culture. For a touring cyclist, it offers a welcoming stop for quality drinks and baked goods with online pre-ordering available for pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides full contact details, menu, and ordering info, confirming this is a real, operating cafe. The website address ('206-4341 North Rd, Burnaby, British Columbia V3N 4N3') differs from the OSM record in two ways: it includes a unit number ('206') and the city is Burnaby, not North Vancouver as tagged in OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the only confirmed service relevant to cyclists is takeout via an online ordering system.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Burnaby (Lougheed area) per the website address.
OSM address '4341 North Road' is missing the unit number '206'; full address per website is '206-4341 North Rd, Burnaby, BC V3N 4N3'.
OSM record has no phone number; phone (778) 379-3312 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating specialty cafe with a live website, online ordering, and full contact details confirmed.

wow_evidence: specialty cafe… premium matcha, hojicha, and espresso drinks alongside house-made pastries
